about_the_game:
FRUSTRAIN is a first-person anti-utopian adventure blending psychological horror, environmental puzzles, and surreal storytelling.

The game unfolds over a single night, seen through the eyes of several passengers suffering from insomnia aboard a never-ending train. Each chapter tells the story of one of them — the conductor, the journalist, the prisoner, and others — revealing how their memories and fears overlap inside this claustrophobic journey through a surreal Eastern European world.

As the player moves through the carriages and dives into distorted dreamscapes, reality begins to unravel. Every object, sound, and conversation becomes a piece of a greater puzzle — a reflection of guilt, repression, and the desperate human need to make sense of fear.

KEY FEATURES

  • Multi-Perspective Storytelling — experience one night through the eyes of several insomniac passengers whose memories and perceptions intertwine.

  • A Surreal Eastern-European Dystopia — explore dreamlike spaces inspired by post-Soviet architecture, propaganda cinema, and anxious noir.

  • Environmental Puzzles with Psychological Meaning — solve puzzles woven into the train’s machinery and the characters’ subconscious.

  • Exploration Across Shifting Realities — travel between waking life, memory, and dream fragments.

  • Story-Rich Psychological Horror — uncover the truth hidden beneath repression and guilt.

  • VR Support — immerse yourself completely in the surreal world with SteamVR-compatible headsets.

content_descriptors.notes:
FRUSTRAIN contains mature psychological themes related to fear, guilt, repression, and isolation.
There are no explicit scenes of violence, sex, or gore.
Some sequences depict emotional distress, references to a past crime (such as an implied abduction), and occasional alcohol use.
The overall atmosphere is tense and unsettling, focusing on psychological horror and symbolic imagery rather than graphic content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: SteamVR-compatible headset (Valve Index, HTC Vive, Meta Quest Link, Windows Mixed Reality)
  • Additional Notes: VR supported. Game can also be played in non-VR (desktop) mode. Headphones recommended for full immersion.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 / AMD Ryzen 5 or higher
  • Memory: 16000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: SteamVR-compatible headset (Valve Index, HTC Vive, Meta Quest Link, Windows Mixed Reality)
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Standing or room-scale VR play area suggested for best experience.
